First step: Check if there's eligibility for MNP. Send a text message with the format "CXXZ<username><ID number>" to 10086 to check whether the number is eligible for number portability.

Second step: If the result of the check does not meet the conditions for MNP, you need to reach an agreement about the conditions for porting out with the outgoing service provider based on the result.

202335270200346115009072.user: How to port a number to another network.
202335270200346115009072.system:
I’m sorry for the unpleasant user experience. Dear Customer, how are you? Checking whether mobile number portability conditions are met: send a text message from this phone, typing "CXXZ (your name and ID number)" to 10086; Applying for the mobile number portability authorization code: send a text message from this phone, typing "SQXZ (your name and ID number)" to 10086. 

For China Mobile customers who want to proceed with number portability, please follow these steps: 

First: Check whether mobile number portability conditions are met. Edit and send a text message "CXXZ (your name and ID number)" to 10086 to check whether the number qualifies for mobile number transfer. 

Second: If the queried result shows that conditions for mobile number portability are not met, please work out the conditions for a transfer with the original carrier based on the result. 

Third: If you qualify for mobile number portability, you can apply for the authorization code. Edit and send a text message "SQXZ (your name and ID number)" to 10086 to get the mobile number transfer authorization code which is valid for 60 minutes. 

Fourth: After receiving the authorization code, within its validity period, please come to the intended carrier's business office in your phone number's local area with valid ID and mobile card you applied for the service. Provide the valid authorization code for a successful portability. Once the intended carrier receives a successful activation notification, your phone number becomes officially online. Within 1 hour after completing, you can officially switch to the new carrier.

Kind reminder: 

1) The authorization code is valid for 60 minutes, over time, you have to reapply. Customers are advised to expedite portability procedures after acquiring the authorization code. 

2) Number portability considers you a new user subject to the Real Name Registration of Telephone Users policy. 

3) The new card will become active starting at the next whole point after completion of the portability, usually within an hour, you can use the new card. 

4) Avoid repeated applications in the same period to prevent channel jam leading to a delay in receiving the authorization code. 

5) From the time the authorization code is received until it expires, the operator can only carry out basic communications services, payment services, recharging services, and card replacement services.

Mobile customers need to follow the steps below to handle mobile number portability: 

Step 1: Check whether the conditions for mobile number portability are met: compose a message CXXZ [username]+[ID number], and send it to 10086 to check whether the number qualifies for mobile number portability. 

Step 2: If the result reveals that the conditions for mobile number portability are not satisfied, the customer needs to reach the porting-out conditions with the porting-out party according to the search results. 

Step 3: If the search results meet the conditions for mobile number portability, authorization code can be applied as follows: compose a message SQXZ [username]+[ID number], and send it to 10086 to obtain the mobile number portability authorization code. The code is valid for 60 minutes. 

Step 4: After receiving the authorization code, customers need to bring their valid ID and the mobile SIM card of the service applying for, go to the service hall of their prospective operator where the number belongs within the valid time of the authorization code, and provide the valid port-out authorization code. The porting-in party activates the number and formally connects it to the network after receiving successful activation results. The customer can officially port to the new operator within 1 hour after the procedure is completed.

202897164686244225217478.user: What is the 5GB SA dedicated data in mobile customer service?
202897164686244225217478.system: The 5G network has two types of networking methods, one is SA (Standalone Architecture), and the other is NSA (Non-Standalone Architecture). When your mobile signal displays the 5G network mark, it simply means you have accessed the 5G network, but it doesn't necessarily mean you have accessed it via the SA method. Only when your mobile phone is compatible and has activated SA, and the network your phone is connected to also supports SA service, will you use SA mode for Internet access. Only in this case, the data generated will be counted in the dedicated 5G data package. If your phone has not been upgraded and activated SA, but is accessing the 5G network through the NSA method, the data will not be included in the dedicated 5G data package and will be billed according to your other data plans.
